body: A deep learning toolkit for training and running text-to-speech models.
plain_description: **Turn written content into natural sounding speech for multilingual products and services.** Use ready made models or train and fine tune models for your needs. Convert voices and curate speech datasets.
technical_description: A Python library for text to speech generation with pretrained models, training and fine tuning tools, dataset analysis utilities, and voice conversion. It includes command line and Python APIs, supports multi speaker and multilingual synthesis, and can run a server in Docker.
title: Coqui TTS
